fields.description: Resolved from the Sales Order/Sales Invoice's contact_email at insert time - the Notification that emails the customer their key/URL uses this as its Receiver By Document Field, since `customer` above is a Customer record ID, not an email address.
fields.label: Customer Email

fields.description: The customer's own User.language, resolved via Customer -> Portal User -> User at insert time - used to render the Notification email in the customer's language even though this runs in a background job with no request/session of its own.
fields.label: Language

fields.description: Best-effort extracted from the response JSON below - blank if the target app's response didn't include it. Plain Data, not Password: this key is deliberately emailed to the customer in plaintext, so masking it here would only break `{{ doc.api_key }}` in the Notification template without adding any real protection.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Raw response body (or traceback, on failure) - kept for audit/debugging even when api_key/tenant_url extraction fails.
fields.label: Raw Response
